evidence_cards.content: Sequence #1: AM Opening South Bound at 5:20 AM — Step 1: Operator performs status check on All devices; Steps 2-6: System executes CLOSE Gate 1, CLOSE Gate 2, OPEN WW-Pop-ups, OPEN Draw Light, OPEN EN-Pop-ups, OPEN CMS 9-12.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines second canonical success scenario — operator triggers closing sequence and system executes reverse operational steps to return lanes to closed state.

evidence_cards.content: Sequence #3: PM Opening North Bound at 11:15 AM — Step 1: Operator performs status check on All devices; Steps 2-8: System executes CLOSE Gate 5, then OPENs WW Lights, WW-Pop-ups (x2), EN-Pop-ups, CMS 1-4, EN-Pop-ups, CMS 5-8.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines fourth canonical success scenario — operator triggers final daily shutdown sequence with systematic deactivation of all active devices.

evidence_cards.content: If command control is enabled by another user, and the logging in user is of higher security, the logging in user shall be requested to accept or deny command control.

evidence_cards.content: If another user is logged in with command control and the new user takes command control, the other user is notified.

evidence_cards.content: During 'degraded' mode, the system shall monitor device sensors at the frequency rate stored in the database to take effect only during 'degraded' mode.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative operational path (degraded mode) that diverges from normal monitoring behavior while still allowing command control acquisition — a legal variant of the main flow under different system state conditions.

evidence_cards.content: In general, the system shall monitor the status of all field devices at the frequency specified in the System Control Parameters for that mode.

evidence_cards.content: At any point in an opening or closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step.

evidence_cards.content: To resume an opening or closing sequence after a halt has occurred, the operator shall be able to issue a command to resume if the offending device status can be corrected within a configurable time period as defined in the database and in non-volatile memory.

evidence_cards.content: If the TMC workstations or network server fails, resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North.

evidence_cards.content: If FCU North or South fails... Alternate control at the non-failed FCU (North or South).

evidence_cards.content: If FCUs North and South both fail... Alternate control units: Direct control at DCUs 1-5, and CMS 1-12 control from CMS cabinets.

evidence_cards.content: If any DCU 1-5 fails... Alternate control unit: MCU and manual control at the field devices.

evidence_cards.content: If any MCU fails... Alternate control unit: Manual control at the field devices related to the failed MCU.

evidence_cards.content: If the TMC workstations or network server fails resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North, and the operator shall be able to dial in from a back up computer to either FCU North or FCU south and open and close the reversible lanes.

evidence_cards.content: If FCU North or South fails, there is a loss of changeable messages signs and DCUs associated with the failed FCU, and alternate control is at the non-failed FCU (North or South).

evidence_cards.content: If FCUs North and South both fail, alternate control units are Direct control at DCUs 1-5 and CMS 1-12 control from CMS cabinets, allowing the operator to connect a lap top computer at the DCUs or CMS cabinet to operate devices or perform manual operation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a severe exception flow (total FCU failure) requiring local manual intervention by the operator via laptop connection.

evidence_cards.content: If any DCU 1-5 fails, the alternate control unit is MCU and manual control at the field devices related to the failed DCU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow for specific device controller failure requiring fallback to MCU or manual field control.

evidence_cards.content: If any MCU fails, the alternate control unit is Manual control at the field devices related to the failed MCU, which can be manually controlled/operated from their cabinets (e.g.: Gates).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow for MCU failure requiring physical manual operation at the device level.

evidence_cards.content: If a scheduled operational sequence requires an operator to be logged on to confirm each step of the operation while no operator is currently logged on, an audible alarm will sound to alert the operator to log on to the system.
